harness.profile_delivery: canonical Profile text prepended to the user task prompt

design.primitive: target/shared/observer/api structure and public-test form copied from frozen Reachability p01/p02; workload, task ids, prompts, and locks are new

task_pair.reachability-p03: cycle-and-chord strongly connected graph consumed as six-query batches
task_pair.reachability-p04: the same input consumed as ninety-six two-query batches

design.independence: new graph family (ring plus chords, all nodes mutually reachable), new scale (640 nodes, 816 edges, 192 queries), new task ids, new sha256 lock set
design.stop_rule: score once after eight cells; no p100 acquisition; no redispatch

outcome.token_effect: p000 used 45.8% (p03) and 31.6% (p04) fewer median total tokens than neutral while remaining performance-eligible under the frozen 1.25x gate
outcome.selective_routing_space_interpretation: both tasks resolved to fixed p000, which is the staged-policy target shape: promote one fixed Profile, no per-task crossover required

prospective_economics.comparison: promotion of fixed p000 over the default defer action neutral; one deployment is one task-pair execution

boundary_conditions.model_difference: the replayed break-even of 8 came from gpt-5.6-luna max cells; this replication ran gpt-5.3-codex-spark high, so absolute token scales differ and only the break-even structure is compared
boundary_conditions.acquisition_scale_difference: the replayed staged acquisition of 1,427,833 tokens covered twelve cells plus replication; this prospective wave spent 4,488,477 tokens on eight Spark cells, yet break-even still lands at 8 because per-deployment savings scaled proportionally
boundary_conditions.single_pair_scope: one task pair, two repetitions; a rankcount-style crossover family or a p100-requiring family would need its own frozen protocol
boundary_conditions.not_validated: p100 behavior, live routing, and any assumption that the eighth-deployment rule transfers to other families or models

result.next_action: the staged neutral/p000-first acquisition policy and the qualification-economics break-even gate are now prospectively supported; a second family with expected crossover would test whether staged acquisition remains correct when the best fixed action is not uniform

claim_boundary: Development evidence only. This replication validates the staged acquisition policy and the arithmetic break-even gate on one independent Reachability pair under gpt-5.3-codex-spark. It does not constitute scientific evidence about Profile routing in general and does not authorize live dispatch.
